---
title: "Reference"
---

## Fitting

- `spax_nmf()`: fit the regularized non-negative matrix factorization model.
- `summary()`: report rank, dimensions, iteration count, and final loss.
- `print()`: compact display of the fitted object.

## Matrix and Cube Helpers

- `cube_to_matrix()`: reshape an IFU cube into a spaxel-by-wavelength matrix.
- `matrix_to_cube()`: convert a matrix reconstruction back into cube form.
- `cube_metadata()`: recover metadata carried through reshaping and fitting.

## Components

- `component_map()`: extract a single component-weight map.
- `component_spectrum()`: extract one recovered component spectrum.
- `component_reconstruction()`: isolate the reconstruction from one component.

## Model Methods

- `basis()`: return spectra as wavelength-by-component.
- `coef()`: return component weights as component-by-spaxel.
- `fitted()`: recover the full reconstruction.
- `predict()`: infer component weights or reconstructions for new data.
- `residuals()`: compute data minus model.

## Visualization

- `plot(type = "spectra")`: inspect recovered component spectra.
- `plot(type = "maps")`: inspect component-weight maps.
- `plot(type = "loss")`: inspect optimization behavior.
- `plot_reconstruction()`: compare observed and reconstructed spectra.

## Reproducible Examples

- `simulate_ifu_cube()`: bundled synthetic IFU example.
- `demo_ifu_unmix()`: compact demonstration of the standard workflow.
